title: Hen_Wen's names
description: i changes a few names of a couple achivements, all of the death messages, and a few other random things.
body:
DISCLAMER!!! this changes stuff in the english language, so if your not using english, it doesent work sadly :(

i made this for fun, heres what it does:
-changes some advancedment names (doesent work for some reason)
-changes almost every death message
-changes a few item names
-a few other names

(this mod pairs well with my other mod, Hen_Wen's recorces! go look at it!)
